rows.title: Worker release wait

quantity.behavior: Polls the release word continuously, in batches of yield hints, until a release store is accepted, a continuous-clock sample expires or cancellation is observed.

rows.conditions: One ordinary worker arrived at a phase boundary with no requested attempt released.

interval.starts: phase arrival acknowledged by the worker
interval.ends: release accepted, expiry sampled or cancellation observed

checks.pins: Requested effects stay absent across a delayed release and occur after it; the control does not measure CPU.

rows.title: Controller collection of client stdout

quantity.behavior: Collects the complete child stdout before applying the retention prefix; the allowance bounds retained bytes, not collection memory. The buffer's disposal boundary relative to parsing and rendering is unestablished.

rows.conditions: Any run whose client replies; the large workload's stdout carries the base64 host reply.

checks.pins: An over-allowance producer is reported as receiver loss with its full received count, not as malformed JSON.

rows.title: Host retirement after the reply

quantity.behavior: Schedules its own exit a fixed delay after replying; a client timeout after invocation cancels neither the submitted work nor this retirement.

rows.conditions: Ordinary completion with a delivered reply.

interval.ending_event: host exit observed independently of the host's own report

aftermath.expected_ending: host process exit after the scheduled delay

checks.pins: Single retirement ownership and refusal of a stale timer; the production delay is value-checked, not observed at CLI return.
